# Vendored vRealTime packages

Built from [austinchennn/vRT](https://github.com/austinchennn/vRT) at commit `32b623e` (branch `vdoc-readiness`, PR #21) with `npm run build && npm run pack`, version `0.1.0`.

Replace these tarballs with registry versions once `@vrealtime/*` is published to npm; see [ADR 0002](../../docs/adr/0002-vendored-vrealtime-packages.md).

To update: build and pack in vRT, copy the needed `release/vrealtime-*.tgz` files here, then run `npm install` at the repository root.
